messages:
Ava (PM): heads up — Acme (pilot) just pushed for SAML SSO + tenant-level audit logs before they sign the pilot contract. asking if we can include for MVP. quick thoughts?
Rajat (Sales): Acme will pay upfront if we can commit to SSO and audits in pilot. it's the gating item for their security review.
Emilie (Security): SAML + audit logs are high-touch. SAML requires connector config + IdP metadata storage + periodic cert rotation. audit logs require retention and integrity guarantees. can we scope it to a narrow pilot?
Marcus (Eng): engineering estimate: SAML integration path (one IdP adapter, basic logout) ~5 dev days + testing. Audit logs (append-only store + export) ~4 dev days. But we need E2E tests and infra config. That smells like 2 sprint-days of risk.
Priya (Eng-Infra): infra notes: storing audit logs for 90 days in hot storage is fine; HSM/KMS integration for signing logs adds time. if we avoid HSM for MVP and do signed digests on a daily cron, that cuts time.
Sofia (Customer Success): pilot scope: Acme wants a single-tenant pilot with their SSO only. they don't need multi-tenant RBAC now. they do need audit CSV exports for compliance.
Ava (PM): options: A) Accept feature into MVP and push other nonessential items to v1 (cost + timeline impact). B) Offer a pilot-only backdoor: manual SSO setup + daily export zip and on-demand audit snapshots (semi-manual ops). C) Defer entirely to v1. Which is least risky?
Rajat (Sales): B seems pragmatic — keeps the deal moving and limits engineering commitment. Acme is ok with an "ops-assisted" setup during pilot if we promise automation within v1 timeline.
Emilie (Security): ops-assisted SSO increases manual ops risk but is acceptable if we document owner runbook and have SSO config expire after pilot. we need attestations in contract.
Marcus (Eng): if we do B, engineering work: build a one-off SSO onboarding runbook + a lightweight importer for IdP metadata (2 days) + a script to generate audit CSVs (1 day). schedule-wise that's 3 dev days and 2 infra days for storage + signed digest. much less than full automation.
Priya (Eng-Infra): I'll provision a temporary bucket with restricted access and set up a signed-digest daily job. no HSM for MVP, but we'll log digest checksums to an internal ledger.
LegalBot: Contract note: any ops-assisted promises must have SLAs and exit clauses. don't commit to retention terms longer than 90 days without Legal approval.
Ava (PM): proposal: accept B. MVP will not ship automated tenant admin UI for SSO; instead pilot gets ops-assisted SSO + daily audit exports. v1 backlog: automated SAML onboarding, tenant RBAC, audit UI + HSM signing. timeline delta: +6 calendar days to prepare runbook and scripts.
Marcus (Eng): will create feature branch `pilot/sso-ops` and a feature-flagged SSO path. fallback: toggle off for other customers.
Sofia (Customer Success): I'll draft onboarding checklist and coordinate Acme's IT. will loop Legal on the attestation language.
Rajat (Sales): I'll confirm with Acme and get signature contingent on the ops-assisted flow. they prefer speed.
Emilie (Security): add a security review task: a light pen-test on the SSO flow before enabling for Acme. ETA 4 days.
Ava (PM): acceptance criteria for the pilot: 1) Acme can log in via their IdP; 2) Daily audit CSV export delivered to Acme SFTP; 3) Signed daily digest stored internally; 4) rollback path to disable SSO quickly.
Marcus (Eng): noted. will also add monitoring for auth failure spikes.
Priya (Eng-Infra): alerting: Auth error > 5% in 10m => pager to infra.
LegalBot: will review onboarding attestation and send a redline by EOD.
Ava (PM): thanks all. decision recorded: ops-assisted SSO + audit exports for Acme pilot (MVP). tagging SAML automation and audit UI into v1. I'll update the milestone tracker and notify sales and pilots channel.
thread_preview: Acme requires SAML SSO + audit logs for pilot; team chooses an ops-assisted SSO + daily audit export for MVP to close the deal, automations deferred to v1.
